CustomField.description: Shows Contact Person Status if Contact Record. If Lead Record, shows Lead Person Status. Updated with new formula 8/30/2023 so that status can be seen on standard campaign w campaign member report, request from Brette.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISNULL(ContactId)) , TEXT( Contact.Contact_Status__c ), '') + IF( NOT(ISNULL(LeadId)) , TEXT(Lead.Lead_Person_Status__c ), '')
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows Contact Person Status if Contact Record. If Lead Record, shows Lead Person Status.
CustomField.label: Person Status
